verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair question for an API-driven payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The docs cite the Legal Entity Management and Configuration APIs but never mention a spec file, and the probe found no spec at common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.adyen.com. The probe only checked guessed paths, so a spec could exist elsewhere, which keeps confidence at medium.
